testsuite.name: com.example.chatbar.desktop.DesktopCurrentImagePresentationTest

testcase.name: chat composer cluster and assistant image actions stay compact on the right
role disable collapse expand and edit remain independent from generation
history grid grows with available tool window height
wide Studio uses balanced resizable panes and preserves width across modes
intermediate preview hides saved actions then completion restores them
design settings history and back retain unsent composer without draft writes
narrow Studio keeps compact current image actions above Prompt
V5 unknown is not zero and known account renders a progress bar
tool window exposes resize maximize and close without duplicating content title

testcase.name: only new generation overrides explicit older result selection
zoom preserves cursor anchor and reset clears pan
history grid shift click selects visible inclusive range and refresh clears selection
studio wide and narrow keep result visible and share history authority
compact intermediate keeps externally imported image distinct without claiming History ownership
Studio inline zoom drag reset and image switch preserve draft
AI design is read only conversation with structured modules and anchored composer
